title: CoTTAGE: An Explainable Judge for Text-to-Audio Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.17644v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Rapid progress in text-to-audio (TTA) generation demands reliable and explainable automatic evaluation. However, existing metrics fail to simultaneously deliver high correlation with human judgments and meaningful, audio-grounded explanations, forcing reliance on labor-intensive human evaluation that bottlenecks model development iteration. To address this, we propose CoTTAGE, a reasoning-based evaluator for text relevance (REL) and audio quality (OVL). Following a reason-then-predict paradigm, CoTTAGE first generates an audio-grounded rationale to diagnose errors before predicting scores. Supported by over 10K newly collected human OVL annotations, CoTTAGE is first trained via supervised fine-tuning and then refined with reinforcement learning using a Thurstone-based preference objective that converts sampled score distributions into pairwise preference probabilities and rewards agreement with rankings derived from human judgments. translated_title: CoTTAGE：面向文本到音频生成的可解释评判器
translated_abstract: 文本到音频（TTA）生成领域的快速发展需要可靠且可解释的自动评估方法。然而，现有指标无法同时实现与人类判断的高度相关以及有意义的、基于音频的解释，这迫使研究者依赖耗时费力的人工评估，成为模型开发迭代的瓶颈。为解决这一问题，我们提出了CoTTAGE，一个基于推理的评估器，用于评估文本相关性（REL）和音频质量（OVL）。遵循“先推理后预测”的范式，CoTTAGE在预测分数之前，会先生成基于音频的推理依据来诊断错误。在超过1万条新收集的人类OVL标注的支持下，CoTTAGE首先通过监督微调进行训练，随后利用基于Thurstone的偏好目标进行强化学习优化，该目标将采样的分数分布转换为成对偏好概率，并奖励与人类判断所推导出的排序相一致的结果。
tldr: CoTTAGE是一个采用“先推理后预测”范式的可解释文本到音频生成评估器，它先生成基于音频的错误诊断依据，再预测文本相关性和音频质量分数，并通过监督微调与基于Thurstone偏好目标的强化学习，实现了与人类判断的高度一致。
en_tdlr: CoTTAGE is an explainable judge for text-to-audio generation that follows a reason-then-predict paradigm—generating audio-grounded rationales before scoring text relevance and audio quality—and is trained via supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with a Thurstone-based preference objective to align closely with human judgments.
